title: Spin Textures and Eigenstate Evolution of Isospectrally Patterned Lattices
summary: Isospectrally patterned lattices exhibit a composite band structure with a tunable ratio of localized versus delocalized eigenstates that is controlled by the underlying phase gradient. We show that the lattice Hamiltonian can be interpreted as that of a single spin exposed to a rotating magnetic field which is allowed to hop with a spin-flip across the lattice. In the low- and high-energy part of the band the localized states show an envelope of oscillatory character separated by quasi-nodes.
